title: Vault: raft topology (leader + voters + transit custodian)
description: Runs `nexus topology vault`. Nodes show their live raft roles: the active node is the raft-leader, the two standbys are voters, and vault-transit is the transit seal custodian. Vault is not sharded, so there is no Shards table.

observe.what: Nodes table with raft roles: vault-2 active/raft-leader, vault-1/3 standby/voter, vault-transit transit; no Shards table (Vault is not sharded)

whatProves: VaultAdapter.GetTopologyAsync renders the live raft membership (one raft-leader, two voters) plus the transit custodian node, and correctly omits the Shards section because Vault is an unsharded HA cluster.
